summary: Acceptance is blocked because the RC4 validation receipt and generated manifests do not cryptographically bind to the committed production profile or pipeline they claim to validate. The implementation has sound fail-closed checkpoint validation and shared default-profile activation, but supported entry-point coverage is partly based on source-string assertions rather than execution. Focused pytest reproduction was prevented by the read-only environment having no writable temporary directory.

evidence: `git rev-parse HEAD` returned `366fc22eb53df812dd3f162eb26cdbab46b66b61`.
`git diff 3a62520..HEAD --stat` shows commit 366fc22 adds audit evidence and changes no production pipeline, tuner, bridge, profile, or test implementation.
`git status --short` returned only the untracked current orchestration directory `audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc4/`; no uncommitted implementation files were found.
audits/validation/v571_3a62520_validation.md:3-7 identifies production commit `3a62520`, profile SHA-256 `3620551...`, and checkpoint SHA-256 `7d49031...`.

audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:3-4 records commit `3a62520` and pipeline SHA-256 `d3933b25...`; lines 15-17 record profile SHA-256 `3620551...` and checkpoint SHA-256 `7d49031...`.
Independent validated-environment hashing of the checked-out profile returned `ff81aa0c7d2af6938cbc4c5af5452a11f7503818105a92bb4ffd8c379bdf76fe`, not `3620551...`.

Independent hashing of the Git blobs at both `3a62520` and `HEAD` returned profile SHA-256 `74c9c2519e086820ffae95762877935e0dd5b7539dc829afa49b27260e8c4bdc`, not `3620551...`, and pipeline SHA-256 `4f32c3bccc47723c35ffff86753de0e2daf123d1f3c3368089ac64cd806044c4`, not `d3933b25...`.
The checkpoint independently hashed to `7d49031dbcce31f0600c44146d9b5282b0df6e28bb1fc1bdde6ef2146ed15d25`, agreeing with production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:32 and the receipt.

sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:16550-16556 activates the same default before GUI construction.

tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:505-518 asserts the default production profile selects U-Net-primary, dual-head, global assignment, overlong split configuration, and required Leica metadata.
tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py:154-172 validates the loaded production profile and exact checkpoint identity.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:790-836 rejects missing, malformed, or mismatched checkpoint hashes and rejects probability caches not authenticated to the selected checkpoint.
utils/saturn_unet25d_bridge.py:55-86 seeds inference, disables cuDNN benchmarking, requires deterministic algorithms, and records device/runtime provenance.
utils/saturn_unet25d_bridge.py:141-170 keys the model cache by resolved path, file SHA-256, and device.
tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:443-472 covers cache/checkpoint identity and same-path checkpoint replacement; lines 475-502 covers repeatable CPU dual-head inference.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11654-11749 serializes runtime parameters and archives the exact loaded profile with hashes.

sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11751-11847 archives the checkpoint, resolved calibration, microscope metadata, ROI/exclusion masks, and ordered source-image hashes, failing when required sources disappear.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11850-11866 writes the settings manifest and returns its paths.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13894-13918 defines GUI single-slice and batch controls; lines 16550-16651 dispatch GUI, single-slice, batch, and command-line modes through the production profile.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:15243-15325 dispatches study-manager execution through `run_multisample_study`.
utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:2137-2480 defines the v5.7.1 command-line tuner; utils/tuner_gui_Saturnv5_7_1.py:32-94 constructs its GUI command.

tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:534-543 only checks that implementation filenames occur as strings in study and tuner-GUI source; it does not execute either entry point or prove semantic equivalence.
tests/test_tuner_gui_v57.py:30-125 verifies constructed argument lists, but not successful subprocess execution using the production profile.
No focused test cited in the claim executes the top-level v5.7.1 CLI parser through GUI, single-slice, and batch dispatch or an end-to-end study/tuner launch.
The validated interpreter was used as required.
Focused pytest command failed before collection with `FileNotFoundError: No usable temporary directory found`; the read-only environment permits no writable pytest capture/temp directory.

audits/validation/v571_3a62520_validation.md:16-26 reports py_compile, 214 pytest passes, tuner self-check, and diff-check, but the receipt's production profile and pipeline hashes do not match the corresponding committed blobs.

audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc4/manifest.json:5-11 reports the reviewed commit and a clean worktree, while current `git status --short` shows that audit directory as untracked; this is expected orchestration output but demonstrates the manifest is not itself commit-bound.

The stale/mismatched hashes in audits/validation/v571_3a62520_validation.md:3-11 and audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:3-17 prevent determining which exact production source and profile generated the evidence.

findings.title: RC4 evidence hashes do not match the reviewed production profile or pipeline
findings.impact: The expensive stage, tracking, and report evidence cannot be reproduced from, or attributed to, the reviewed implementation. This violates the claim's commit-bound provenance requirement and makes the high-risk production validation receipt unreliable.
evidence: audits/validation/v571_3a62520_validation.md:3-11 claims the evidence binds production commit `3a62520` and profile SHA-256 `3620551...`.
audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:3-17 claims pipeline SHA-256 `d3933b25...` and profile SHA-256 `3620551...`.

Validated-environment hashing returned Git-blob SHA-256 values `4f32c3bc...` for the pipeline and `74c9c251...` for the profile at both `3a62520` and `HEAD`; checked-out-file hashes also do not equal the recorded values.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate or formally supersede the receipt and evidence manifests using hashes computed directly from the exact Git blobs, record the reviewed evidence commit and production parent explicitly, verify every listed artifact hash, and start a new append-only audit run.

findings.title: Supported entry-point equivalence is not established by integration tests
findings.impact: Regressions in argument parsing, default-profile activation, GUI dispatch, batch dispatch, study orchestration, or tuner subprocess launch could pass the current tests despite the claim covering all those workflows.
evidence: tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:534-543 uses source substring assertions for study and tuner selection.
tests/test_tuner_gui_v57.py:30-125 validates command construction but not subprocess execution.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:16584-16651 contains materially distinct top-level dispatch branches without a corresponding subprocess-level test cited by the claim.
findings.recommendation: Add focused integration tests that invoke the top-level CLI parser for GUI selection, single-slice, batch, and explicit-profile paths; execute study and tuner launchers with mocked expensive inference while asserting identical loaded production semantics and failure propagation.

findings.title: Current audit-run directory is untracked after its manifest recorded a clean tree
findings.impact: It does not alter production behavior, but consumers must not mistake the orchestration files for commit-bound evidence.
evidence: `git status --short` returned `?? audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc4/`.
audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc4/manifest.json:7-10 records `dirty_worktree: false` and an empty status list.
findings.recommendation: Have the audit coordinator clearly distinguish generated orchestration state from reviewed commit contents in the final gate record.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as instructed.
Other reviewers' outputs were not read.
Focused pytest execution and collection were blocked by the managed read-only filesystem because pytest could not create capture or temporary files.
GUI rendering and interactive dialogs were inspected statically rather than launched.
Commit-bound evidence was preferred, but its source/profile hash mismatch prevents accepting it as reproducible validation.
recommended_follow_up: Supersede the mismatched RC4 validation receipt and manifests in a new audit run.
Run the documented validated-environment test suite in a writable clean checkout and attach machine-readable command results.
Add subprocess-level entry-point integration tests covering CLI, GUI selection, single-slice, batch, tuner, and study-manager semantics.
Re-run the independent software-reproducibility review after provenance and integration evidence are corrected.
